releaseNotes: V725 fixes the V724 regression where the SMC vendor logo and IODD product PNG could disappear on first connection.
Generic startup/session IsConnected=false transitions no longer invalidate the Master REST presentation token; only confirmed stable physical down edges invalidate a port identity.
Explicit Disconnect/Connect still requires fresh serial identity verification but preserves the last REST presentation snapshot until a real hot-swap or serial-vs-REST conflict is confirmed.
V724 hot-swap identity refresh logic is otherwise retained.

en: V725 fixes the V724 regression where the SMC vendor logo and IODD product PNG could disappear on first connection.
Generic startup/session IsConnected=false transitions no longer invalidate the Master REST presentation token; only confirmed stable physical down edges invalidate a port identity.
Explicit Disconnect/Connect still requires fresh serial identity verification but preserves the last REST presentation snapshot until a real hot-swap or serial-vs-REST conflict is confirmed.
V724 hot-swap identity refresh logic is otherwise retained.
ko: V724에서 재발한 최초 연결 시 SMC 제조사 로고 및 IODD 제품 PNG 누락을 수정했습니다.
초기화/세션 재구성 중 발생하는 일반 IsConnected=false 상태에서는 Master REST Presentation 토큰을 삭제하지 않으며, 확정된 stable physical down edge에서만 해당 포트 identity를 무효화합니다.
Disconnect/Connect 시 fresh serial identity 1회 검증은 유지하되, 실제 hot-swap 또는 serial/REST 충돌이 확인되기 전까지 기존 REST Presentation snapshot을 보존합니다.
V724의 온라인 포트 교차교체 재식별 로직은 그대로 유지합니다.
